title: Komatsu Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Komatsu value, monetary plumbing, and bitcoin models.
coverage_note: Entire report and chart inventory read; included policy timing, crypto politics, mining, model criticism, Komatsu, dollar-cycle exposure and mortgage transmission.

claims.reason: The near-term window is now historical. Exact chart definition and range tolerance are required before an objective breakout test.

claims.reason: New bill purchases began in December 2025, matching the year. This does not equate reserve management with a broad risk-asset stimulus program.

evidence.title: Reserve management purchases
evidence.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
evidence.finding: The Desk announced $40 billion of initial bill purchases starting December 12, to maintain ample reserves. This is not itself evidence of deficit monetization as the causal motive.

claims.claim: Debt ceiling can release Treasury cash.
claims.reason: The ceiling bound in 2025 and Treasury cash was drawn down, so this is no longer a pending scenario. The cash-release mechanism is supported, while the final reserve effect depends on the rest of the Fed balance sheet.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: Fiscal2025 federal debt audit
evidence.finding: Debt ceiling reinstatedJanuary2 2025; extraordinary measuresJanuary21-July7; July4 law raised limit$5tn to$41.1tn. FY2025deficit$1.8tn.

evidence.title: Treasury cash observations
evidence.finding: Weekly WTREGEN January 1, 2025 $719.873bn; April 9, 2025 $306.049bn, a $413.824bn drawdown during the extraordinary-measures period. Latest vintage downloaded November 7, 2026. Reserve effects also depend on other liabilities and assets.

claims.reason: Interruptibility can make mining useful, but actual net benefit requires curtailment baselines, grid costs and alternative buyers. A company partnership announcement is not a measured outcome.

claims.reason: Mining is unusually location-flexible and interruptible. AI inference may need latency and reliable connectivity, but model training is not uniformly close to end users; the generalization needs workload separation.

claims.claim: Curve fits cannot determine bitcoin demand.
claims.reason: Extrapolating past prices is not an identified demand model. Model fit alone cannot establish invariant future adoption or causal law; the earlier 2020 target is historical, not a fresh forecast.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Narrow deductive identity only; no empirical forecasting credit.

assumptions: Only a finite historical set of price observations is known
No independently established structural demand restriction
proof.derivation: Infinitely many functions fit the same finite observations yet diverge afterward. Historical fit alone therefore does not uniquely determine future prices.

claims.reason: Entrenchment is a plausible qualitative advantage, but there is no quantified failure probability or valuation translation.

claims.claim: Liquidity is bitcoin principal macro correlate.

claims.claim: Mining economics and cohorts guide valuation.

claims.reason: Most is a relative outcome claim requiring a benchmark basket and common window. A weaker dollar does not automatically dominate growth shocks.

assessment: The ether-ETF timing, 2025 Fed turn and absence of a new mortgage-rate trough are supported. The report is appropriately skeptical of deterministic bitcoin price models. Komatsu valuation and EM rotation need independent relative-return testing; the thesis expressly allows a long wait.
